# LSTM Crime Forecasting

- `src/crime_forecasting/config.py`: immutable TOML configuration.
- `src/crime_forecasting/data.py`: daily aggregation and calendar validation.
- `src/crime_forecasting/windows.py`: safe chronological supervised windows.
- `src/crime_forecasting/scaling.py`: leakage-free 3D standardization.
- `src/crime_forecasting/backend.py`: lazy TensorFlow/KerasTuner boundary.
- `src/crime_forecasting/evaluation.py`: horizon metrics and residuals.
- `src/crime_forecasting/artifacts.py`: result persistence.
- `src/crime_forecasting/service.py`: pipeline orchestration.
- `tests/`: deterministic offline tests.
- `design-diagrams/`: historical, non-executable telecommunications diagrams.
